Ilya: heads-up: our edge ESM sample (rollup/esbuild mix) ends up with Authorization header === undefined at runtime after bundling. CJS output unaffected.
Nora: can you share the smallest repro + tsconfig?
Ilya: attached minimal. TS uses a generic overload on the client: `request<T>(url:string): Promise<T>; request<T>(url:string, opts:RequestOptions<T>): Promise<T>;` RequestOptions<T> references `auth?: { token: string } | T` and we use `unknown` in some conditional types.
Ilya: dev (ts-node) -> ok. bundle (rollup + terser) -> emitted helper shows `opts` but no `opts.auth`. result: `Authorization` header missing -> 401 -> sdk retries.
Diego: hmm, overloads + conditional types can be type-only in emit. rollup treeshaker + the commonjs plugin sometimes elides tiny forwarding helpers if TS erases the runtime signal. also `isolatedModules:true` or `importsNotUsedAsValues:"remove"` can remove value imports.
Nora: did you try `compilerOptions.importsNotUsedAsValues = "preserve"` (or TS >=5.x `preserveValueImports`) and disabling terser/minify to see if treeshake is the culprit?
Ilya: yes. setting importsNotUsedAsValues=preserve + minify=false fixes it. Repro: before: `send(u,o){o=o||{};const h=o.headers||{};/* o.auth undefined */}` after: `send(u,o){o=o||{};const h=o.headers||{};h.Authorization=o.auth?.token}`
Diego: good find. Short-term workaround for samples: avoid overload shapes that only differ by generics at the exported boundary. Instead use a single runtime-visible signature like `request(url, opts?: RequestOptions<any>)` and narrow types internally.
Nora: also add a small CI check: compile the SDK typings and then bundle with rollup/esbuild to assert `opts.auth` appears in emitted JS. Prevent regressions.
Ilya: opening a tiny samples PR with the repro and a blurb under onboarding: "Edge/ESM bundling can erase type-only overloads -> missing headers; recommended tsconfig and bundler flags included."
BuildBot: CI: edge-esm-overload-repro #9 failed (repro shows missing Authorization header) :warning:
